channel.title: Nature Communications
channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [7] Singularity-free supertwisted atomic layers with giant circular dichroisms
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Xiaopeng Fan, Kaihui Liu

Authors: Xinchao Wang, Kaifeng Lin, Guodong Xue, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Relevant study on twisted vdW multilayers and circular dichroism, aligning with interest in chiral/moire physics.

Tags: #material #WS2 #twisted-vdW #circular-dichroism

Abstract: Supertwisted van der Waals multilayers show interesting chiroptical properties, but their growth process usually involves a topological singularity and in-plane strain. Here, the authors report the synthesis of singularity-free supertwisted WS2 multilayers showing linear-optical circular dichroism (CD) of up to 10 mdeg and a second-harmonic CD of up to 0.81.
